notFound.title: Server not found
notFound.body: This server has no Lineup profile. Claim it first from the claim page.

forbidden.title: You do not manage this server
forbidden.body: You must own the server, or have the Administrator or Manage Server permission. If you just received these rights, read your servers again from the claim page.

description.title: Description
description.label: Server description
description.hint: Leave empty to show the Discord description.
description.discordNone: This server has no description on Discord.

links.title: Links
links.hint: Up to {{count}} links, https only. The label is 40 characters at most.
links.label: Link {{n}} label

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Separated by commas. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 24 characters. {{count}} of {{max}}.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.lost: It no longer exists on Discord: replace it.
invite.label: New invitation
invite.hint: Optional. It must never expire and lead to this same server.
invite.how: How to create a permanent invitation

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.label: Show the server in the directory
visibility.on: Anyone can find this profile in the directory.
visibility.off: The profile and its posts disappear for everyone except managers and the Moddy staff.

errors.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields, then save again.
errors.linkLabel: A label of 1 to {{max}} characters is required.
errors.tagPattern: "{{tag}}" is not valid: 2 to 24 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
errors.inviteLength: Enter a code or a link of 2 to 200 characters.

snapshot.title: Discord data
snapshot.body: Name, icon and counts are read again every 6 hours. You can force a new read once a minute.
snapshot.staleDone: Discord did not answer: the old data is kept.

danger.title: Delete the profile
danger.body: The profile leaves the directory and the server's posts are closed. The Discord server is not affected.
danger.effectPosts: Draft and published posts become "closed". You can reopen them after claiming the server again.
danger.effectHidden: Posts hidden by the Moddy team stay hidden.
danger.effectReclaim: The description, links, tags and visibility settings are lost.

posts.title: Server posts
posts.emptyAll: This server has no posts yet. Everyone who manages the server can edit all of them.
posts.hidden: Hidden by the Moddy team: it can no longer be changed.
